name: echo focused
description: Proposal, a mood for the idle rotation on the 40 cell lattice (12 px cells, the creature at 2x), the stillest cell in the batch: the creature rests and blinks, its eyes narrow from the top and then the bottom to two row slits, a thin reticle of four ping corner brackets draws itself round the visor one corner at a time, wide at first, then locks on, closing in to the band with a tick top and bottom, it holds dead still with the slits a col in toward the middle, blinks once slowly, holds again, then the reticle dims and goes and the eyes open; judge whether the brackets read as a reticle on the face rather than a frame on the body, whether the slow blink reads as deliberate, and whether it is still this creature.
